scripts.dev: npm run build -w @netsim/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @netsim/shared" "npm run dev -w @netsim/server" "npm run dev -w @netsim/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @netsim/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @netsim/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test
